_about: Machine-readable release lifecycle of mrmap (issue #1585, epic #1577). This file is the interface the documentation automation (#1604) generates from and the interface tests (#1586) verify against. scripts/test_release_lifecycle.py holds every fact here against the workflows, scripts and docs it names: a drift between this description and the tooling fails the suite, so the generated prose cannot outlive the mechanism. It describes the lifecycle, not the schedule; nothing dated or countable belongs here.

images.promotion_mode: --promote by digest; the tested bytes are tagged, never rebuilt
images.stable_alias_rule: a stable version tag never moves once written
images.note: the publisher workflow is deliberately not wired yet (#1581); the tool and its policy are committed and tested today

documentation_versions.excluded: release candidates and prerelease suffixes carry no published documentation

phases.action: code changes only; the canonical VERSION file is never hand-edited in a PR
release-please opens the Version Release PR; a human approves and merges it; the merge tags vX.Y.Z and advances master
images for the candidate are built and attested by digest; the contract, version and upgrade gates judge the exact master merge commit (#1799/#1800)

one manual dispatch of the promotion workflow verifies the merged release pull request and, behind the protected environment, publishes it; verify refuses a candidate that is not master's tip, an unpublished version, or a tag that already stands elsewhere
phases.mechanism: native Actions jobs, needs and concurrency plus gh and git; the steps are written in the workflow itself and scripts/test_release_promotion.py runs them out of the workflow text, so no promotion tool exists to drift
phases.publishing: disabled until the build and gate jobs of #1799/#1800 are wired in front of it: the approved job rehearses and writes nothing

phases.action: the tag and the GitHub release stand on the merge commit that was verified and reviewed; the version upgrade gate re-runs against master's migrations before anything is called stable

the release issue family is closed and the next maintenance versions announced; the master-to-develop sync is an ordinary reviewed pull request, and the planner re-anchors on the tag the promotion pushed
phases.evidence: .github/workflows/release-promotion.yml verify step and the ordinary sync PR of docs/source/development/github-flow.rst

constraints.version_bumping: automatic via release-please reading conventional commit classes; no contributor edits version fields
constraints.permanent_branch_pushes: no agent pushes develop or master; the promotion path writes a tag and a release, and a human merges
constraints.approvals: humans alone approve, merge and resolve
constraints.issue_closing: the promotion path never closes issues
constraints.security_fix_class: fix(security) is a patch unless it breaks an API shape, which is a major
constraints.changelog: CHANGELOG.md is maintained by the Version Release PR, never by hand
